content.title: Table 2 - Levels of evidence

figures.description: Three-tier levels of evidence (A, B, C) shown in two identical panels on the page.

levels_of_evidence.description: Data derived from multiple randomized clinical trials or meta-analyses.
Data derived from a single randomized clinical trial or large non-randomized studies.
Consensus of opinion of the experts and/or small studies, retrospective studies, registries.

conflicts_of_interest.summary: Experts of the writing and reviewing panels provided declaration of interest forms for all relationships perceived as real or potential conflicts. Forms were compiled into one file and made available on the ESC website. Any changes during writing were notified and updated. The Task Force received its entire financial support from the ESC without involvement from the healthcare industry.

guideline_development_and_review.summary: The ESC CPG (Clinical Practice Guidelines committee) supervises and coordinates preparation of new guidelines, endorses them, and oversees extensive review by the CPG and external experts. After revisions, the finalized document is approved by the CPG for publication in the European Heart Journal.
guideline_development_and_review.notes: Guidelines developed after consideration of contemporary scientific and medical knowledge and available evidence at time of dating.

content.page_notes: Page contains repeated diagram of levels of evidence and textual paragraphs about declarations of interest and guideline development.
